task.title: Evolve the Emacs interface with bounded observational context
task.objective: Complete issues https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1027, https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1029, https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1033, https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1035, https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1037, and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/1039 by exposing useful live editor context without widening the read-only model-neutral authority boundary.
acceptance_criteria: Expose restriction bounds, text revision, and non-reused process-local live-buffer identity while preserving editor state.
Expose bounded current-buffer native project, Flymake, and compilation observations without request-time library loading or searching, file reads, unrelated-buffer selection, or starting work.
Reject malformed, oversized, duplicate, inherited, and unsupported added-section state before unbounded copying or traversal.
Document each observational authority boundary and verify every slice through focused ERT and the complete repository quality gate.

attempts.summary: Added observational restriction bounds, text revision, and live-buffer identity through separate RED to GREEN slices.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused RED runs established that snapshots could not report accessible bounds, correlate observations with exact buffer text, or distinguish a killed buffer from a later buffer reusing its display name.
attempts.patch: Pull requests https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1028, https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1030, and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1034 added preserved point-min and point-max metadata, a character modification tick, and opaque process-local non-reused live-buffer tokens; expanded state-preservation, lifecycle, reload, and protocol-version tests; and documented that tokens are not durable identities or authorization.

attempts.summary: Added bounded native project and current-line Flymake context without filesystem or backend authority.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused RED runs showed that callers lacked structured project roots and current-line diagnostics, while naive discovery or diagnostic projection could search load paths, visit files, expose backend objects, return unbounded metadata, or mutate match data.
attempts.patch: Pull requests https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1036 and https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1038 used native project and Flymake APIs already required by the package in the current buffer; returned nullable project roots and ordered bounded diagnostic metadata; rejected oversized, malformed, improper, and zero-width observations; preserved match data and source-buffer state; and documented immediate staleness and non-authority.

attempts.summary: Added bounded current-buffer native compilation progress after pinning lifecycle and counter semantics.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused RED runs established missing protocol metadata and shapes for active and inactive processes, malformed or inherited counters, five-section width, complete-response encoding, and editor-state preservation.
attempts.patch: Pull request https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/1040 advanced the protocol to version 7; recognized only the current native compilation buffer without request-time compilation-library loading or searching; reported live associated-process state and bounded buffer-local error, warning, and info counters; rejected malformed state; updated finite response budgets; and documented that inactive does not prove any completion outcome.

attempts.summary: Preserved the compilation pull request through a false-green rate limit and resumed review once after the stated cooldown.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit initially published a successful status whose comment explicitly said the review was rate limited, so the exact head lacked a genuine substantive review and was not merge-ready.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disabled, recorded the blocker once, waited beyond the published cooldown, confirmed the shared review budget, triggered one deliberate review, required the substantive exact-head walkthrough with no actionable findings and zero threads, then armed squash auto-merge.

outcome.summary: Protocol version 7 now correlates bounded live-buffer identity and revision with restriction, native project, current-line Flymake, and current-buffer compilation observations while retaining a read-only owner-thread boundary and explicit finite request and response budgets.

verification.command: exact-head Rust quality gates for pull requests 1028, 1030, 1034, 1036, 1038, and 1040
substantive exact-head CodeRabbit reviews for pull requests 1028, 1030, 1034, 1036, 1038, and 1040 with zero unresolved threads before each merge

lessons: A live-buffer observation needs both a process-local non-reused identity and a text revision; names, files, and ticks alone do not establish exact buffer identity across lifecycle changes.
Narrowing bounds can be observed without widening, and snapshot code must preserve point, mark, restriction, text properties, modification state and tick, undo state, and match data.
Native project and Flymake APIs are safe only behind current-buffer, already-callable, bounded projection contracts that do not load libraries, read files, expose backend objects, or imply freshness.
Compilation progress counters are transient native observations; a missing live process does not prove success, failure, completion, cancellation, or prior execution.
Every added optional section must update pre-copy request width and the deterministic encoder node budget for the largest complete legal response.
A green review status is not sufficient when the accompanying review explicitly reports rate limiting; merge readiness requires substantive exact-head review content and zero unresolved threads.
